audited_commit: origin/main b595a51 (data refresh 2026-10-08); code paths below
purpose: Machine-readable map of what actually produces GOING's numbers and recommendations, so research compares against the real system (the Champion), not a toy baseline. Facts were read from code and verified against the frozen 2026 tracker; items marked inferred were not verified.

champion_definition.player_markets: weighted trailing-window mean per market (scripts/build_pipeline.py build_profiles/season_fit/fit_stat), then optional QB pressure scale and injury/availability/next-man-up adjustment (index.html attachProjection, shared/football-injuries.js), then Poisson (counts) or lognormal+empirical-mass (yardage) pricing (index.html propProbabilities)
champion_definition.window: last 12 regular-season appearances across seasons (QB: verified schedule starts within 730 days), minimum 5, zero-stat appearances taken from snap counts
champion_definition.weights: 80% spread equally over current-season games and 20% over earlier-season games when both are present; equal weights otherwise (build_pipeline.py season_weights). Documented as 'product policy, unvalidated'. No within-season recency weighting, no shrinkage to a position prior, no rookie handling
champion_definition.reconstruction: scripts/trend_research/champion.py reproduces the production mean exactly (to 1e-6) for 91% of frozen receptions and receiving-yards records, 95% of atd, 100% of pass_tds, 79% of rush_yds and 59% of pass_yds (differences are injury/role adjustments and QB start selection); recorded probability equals Poisson(projection_mean) for every frozen receptions record that stores projection_mean
champion_definition.ffopportunity: NOT a projection input: expected points appear only in descriptive facts (opportunity_evidence.py)

rec_yds.distribution: lognormal on positive games + empirical <=0 mass
rec_yds.uncertainty: weighted SD, deflated when one season dominates the weights

rec_tds.note: modeled in profiles, zero quotes in the odds feed

carries.note: not a market; only a descriptive workload fit

pass_yds.distribution: lognormal + empirical mass over verified starts

game_sides_totals.model: team trailing scoring: home pts = mean(home scored, away allowed), 12 games, 80/20 season weights; normal margin/total with SD from up to 1000 walk-forward residuals; NO opponent strength, home field, injury, weather, rest or market blending; moneyline from the same margin

season_transition.after_one_game: that single game carries 80% of the weight although the 11 earlier games satisfy the n>=5 gate; effective_n about 1.5
season_transition.after_four_games: four current games share 80%, eight prior share 20%
season_transition.self_review: scripts/current_season_review.py compares 80/20 with equal weights each refresh; in 2026 80/20 has HIGHER RMSE than equal weights in every market (pass_yds 94.0 vs 86.4, pass_tds 1.263 vs 1.144, rush_yds 24.29 vs 23.99, rec_yds 25.89 vs 24.32, receptions 1.884 vs 1.817, atd 0.545 vs 0.502)
season_transition.validation_in_this_repo: E7 (2021-2025 walk-forward, reconstructed Champion): see ledger.json

decision_layer.no_bet_pass_tier: There is no BET/PASS tier anywhere; every UI string disclaims calibration and edge

pipelines.board: signalCandidates -> rankBestPlays: best_model = highest model win chance first (favourites lead) subject to fresh-ish quote, n>=5, no 'check' flag; tracked only when EV>=3% and the 'gap' flag (defined as EV>=3%) and no check flag
pipelines.best_value: reference-book consensus (Pinnacle required) vs recreational book; ZERO frozen predictions exist
pipelines.going_picks_v2: football-case-v2 evidence rating /100 (see rating inputs); independent of price, EV and model probability except as an eligibility check
pipelines.all_projection: every projected play (one line per family nearest -110, odds >= -500): the unselected universe, the right baseline

going_rating_inputs.rating formula: (tier-1)*20 + 1 + round(19*strength), strength = clamp(directional gap / model SD, 0, 1)

decision_layer.going_score: separate /100 player index, slate-percentile based, Over-only, 5 markets; ATD blends 20% book-implied probability
decision_layer.price_effects: Rating ignores price. Tracker applies a -500 odds floor to every group except going_picks (v1/v2 bypass it). best_model drops EV>25% as a 'check'

frozen_record_fields: provenance hashes of every input file
known_gaps: closing-price records are scheduled later observations, not closes: none is flagged near-kickoff and the median is 3.8 days before kickoff, so closing-line value cannot be measured honestly
frozen records do not store the unadjusted mean, the injury scale, the lognormal parameters or the game log; exact replay needs the hashed input files
the same bet appears in several tracking groups and as both sides in all_projection: groups are not independent samples; the game is the cluster
